title: Offered-day follow-up with a specific time keeps the offered date
description: The caller first asks for nearest first-consultation terms, then refers back to the offered day and asks for a different specific hour. The follow-up lookup must keep the date from the active slot offer instead of degrading to a time-only lookup over the default horizon.

turns.user: Chcialbym umowic pierwsza konsultacje. To moja pierwsza wizyta. Jakie sa najblizsze wolne terminy w ciagu najblizszego miesiaca?
A czy pierwszy z tych terminow, tego samego dnia, o dwudziestej tez jest wolne?

rubric.description: The assistant should look up first-visit consultation slots on the initial nearest-term request.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant stopped calling checkAvailability for the initial first-visit lookup

rubric.description: The scenario needs an active offered slot so the follow-up can reference its date.
rubric.root_cause_hint: staging availability fixture no longer has a first-consultation slot for the nearest-term lookup

rubric.description: The assistant should refresh availability when the caller changes the offered day to a specific hour.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant reused the previous offer or answered without checking the new requested hour

rubric.description: The follow-up should normalize the requested hour to specific_time.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant dropped the caller's explicit nineteen hundred preference

rubric.description: The follow-up should pass twenty hundred as requestedTime.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant did not pass the caller's specific requested hour to checkAvailability

rubric.description: The follow-up should keep the date from the first offered slot instead of becoming a time-only lookup.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant omitted requestedDate when the caller referenced the active offered day

rubric.description: A specific hour on an offered day should stay bounded to that one date.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant widened the active offered-day follow-up into a multi-day time search

rubric.description: This lookup-only scenario must not create a booking.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant advanced into booking before the caller selected a concrete slot
